item.title: Native Amazon EKS Backups with AWS Backup
item.description: TL;DR: AWS Backup now protects Amazon EKS. It backs up your cluster state and persistent data (EBS, EFS, S3) using one policy-driven workflow. You can restore a full cluster, a namespace, or specific volumes even into a brand-new EKS cluster. It’s been available since Nov 2025, and it’s now a dependable option for production teams.
